tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search published JPFreeSoft entries by keywords and explicit facts. Exact filters exclude unknown values. Returns source URLs and unconfirmed fields; results are not ranked recommendations. Types: software, ai_tool. Maximum 10 results with offset pagination.

tools.name: get_catalog_entry
tools.description: Read a published entry using the type and slug from search_catalog. Includes recorded facts, source URL, official/download links and bounded plain-text content. Missing fields remain null. Does not fetch external links or install software.
